FINGERPRINT_CREATE_MODEL: fingerprint create model from buffers 1 and 2
FINGERPRINT_INIT_TOOLTIP: Upload mode only. Board RX connects to sensor TX, board TX to sensor RX. Defaults: RX 10, TX 11, 57600 baud. The baud rate must match the sensor. Use distinct pins. On Leonardo, RX requires a pin-change-interrupt pin.
FINGERPRINT_OPERATION_TOOLTIP: Sends one sensor command. Check last status or last operation succeeded before the next enrollment or search step. No finger is a normal capture result.
FINGERPRINT_DELETE_TOOLTIP: Permanently deletes only the specified sensor model. Valid IDs start at 1 and must be below sensor capacity. Check the last status afterward.
FINGERPRINT_CACHED_TOOLTIP: Reads the result of the last command without communicating with the sensor. Matched ID and confidence are 0 when no match is available.
FINGERPRINT_COUNT_TOOLTIP: Reads the cached stored count without communicating with the sensor. -1 means unknown; run refresh stored count to update it.
FINGERPRINT_STATUS_TOOLTIP: A status constant to compare with last status. Does not send a sensor command.
